facts.en: Completed a heritage visitor-services diploma at Fictional Fernarch College in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构蕨拱学院完成文化遗产游客服务文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid visitor host at Fictional Rosequill Historic Garden from 2020-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2020-03 至 2026-08 在虚构玫羽历史花园任有薪访客接待员。

facts.en: Welcomed visitors at the gate, checked timed-entry tickets and explained the day’s open routes.
facts.zh: 在入口欢迎访客、检查定时入场票，并说明当天开放路线。

facts.en: Used the gardener-approved daily route board to explain closures and step-free options without promising access to closed paths.
facts.zh: 依据园艺负责人批准的每日路线板，说明封闭路段及无台阶路线，不承诺可进入封闭路径。

facts.en: Led short garden-history walks using the curator’s approved interpretation notes.
facts.zh: 使用策展人批准的解说备注，带领简短花园历史导览。

facts.en: Directed questions outside the approved notes to the curator and logged requested follow-up information.
facts.zh: 将超出获批备注范围的问题转交策展人，并记录请求跟进的信息。

facts.en: Helped refresh the visitor welcome sheet in 2024-04 after a path junction changed.
facts.zh: 2024-04 在一个路径交叉口变更后，协助更新访客欢迎页。

facts.en: Personally checked printed direction arrows against the approved route board; the gardener confirmed path access conditions.
facts.zh: 个人依据获批路线板核对印刷方向箭头；路径通行状况由园艺负责人确认。

facts.en: The 2025-06 host rota assigned 18 scheduled history walks to the candidate; it does not record completion or complete visitor headcounts.
facts.zh: 2025-06 的接待排班为候选人安排了 18 次计划历史导览；未记录完成情况或完整访客人数。

facts.en: Recorded group-arrival times and contacted booked groups when weather-related closures were confirmed by the duty manager.
facts.zh: 记录团队抵达时间，并在值班经理确认天气相关封闭后联系已预订团队。

facts.en: Kept a daily handover of unresolved visitor questions, borrowed umbrella returns and changed meeting points.
facts.zh: 维护每日交接，记录未解决访客问题、借出雨伞归还及集合点变更。

facts.en: Uses a ticket scanner, group-booking calendar and printed interpretation prompts.
facts.zh: 使用验票扫描器、团队预订日历及纸质解说提示。

facts.en: Completed the garden’s internal visitor-access orientation in 2020-03.
facts.zh: 2020-03 完成花园内部访客通行入门培训。

facts.en: Worked with a colleague to test a revised welcome sheet using 6 fictional visitor questions in 2024-05.
facts.zh: 2024-05 与一名同事使用 6 个虚构访客问题，测试修订后的欢迎页。

facts.en: Personally noted unclear meeting-point wording; the colleague checked the opening-time table.
facts.zh: 个人记录不清晰的集合点措辞；同事检查开放时间表。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Hazelpage Local History Circle from 2017-09 to 2019-06, arranging photo-display labels supplied by the organizer.
facts.zh: 2017-09 至 2019-06 在虚构榛页地方历史社做志愿者，整理组织者提供的照片展示标签。

facts.en: Created a personal notebook of imagined garden stories and original sketches in 2023; it was fiction, not historical research.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人笔记，包含想象中的花园故事及原创素描；内容为虚构创作，而非历史研究。

facts.en: Participates in an amateur shadow-puppet group and helps make paper scenery for informal performances.
facts.zh: 参加业余皮影小组，并协助为非正式表演制作纸质布景。

facts.en: Enjoys collecting fallen leaves for shape sketches where collection is permitted.
facts.zh: 爱好在允许采集的地点收集落叶，进行形状素描。
